name: Dr. Helena Varghese
bio: Helena has taught in four countries and led two schools before founding Aurelia Hall. She still teaches a Sixth Form literature seminar every week, because, as she says, 'a head who stops teaching stops listening.'
quote: Ambition and kindness are not opposites. We teach them together.

name: Anika Rao
bio: Anika designed our garden classroom and forest school programme. She believes the best early learning looks a lot like play — because it is.
quote: Children learn most when they don't notice they're learning.

name: Meera Chandran
bio: Meera leads the Prep years and teaches maths to Year 6. Her lessons are famous for their puzzles, their noise and their 'aha' moments.
quote: Every girl is a mathematician. Some just haven't been introduced yet.

name: Sophia D'Silva
bio: Sophia oversees academic progress and pastoral care for Years 7 to 11. A historian by training, she runs the school's Model United Nations society.
quote: History teaches us to ask: who is telling this story, and why?

name: Ritu Nair
bio: Ritu leads the Sixth Form and teaches A Level Economics. She coordinates university guidance and the Year 12 internship fortnight.
quote: Sixth Form is a rehearsal for independence. We make it a good one.

name: Kavya Iyer
bio: Kavya left a research lab to teach and has never looked back. She runs the Glasshouse science wing and the Saturday science olympiad club.
quote: If it doesn't fizz a little, we haven't done it right.

name: Farah Sheikh
bio: Farah built the sports programme from a single field into twelve sports. Her rule: everyone plays, everyone improves.
quote: Confidence is built on the field long before it shows up in the exam hall.

name: Leela Menon
bio: A cellist and conductor, Leela leads the orchestra, three choirs and the annual musical. Half the school learns an instrument with her team.
quote: A choir is just a group of people agreeing to listen to each other.

name: Nandini Kulkarni
bio: Nandini oversees the four boarding houses and the team of houseparents. She knows every boarder's name, birthday and favourite breakfast.
quote: A boarding house should feel like the kindest version of home.

name: Zara Bose
bio: Zara runs The Atelier, our design, making and enterprise studio. She has worked in product design studios and still sketches on everything.
quote: Make the thing. Then make it better. Then make it useful.

name: Priya Hegde
bio: Priya teaches French and Hindi and organises the annual language exchange. She speaks five languages and is learning a sixth.
quote: Every new language is a new way of paying attention.

name: Isha Kapoor
bio: Isha leads our wellbeing team and trains Sixth Form peer listeners. Her door — and her biscuit tin — are always open.
quote: Asking for help is a skill. We practise it here.
